node.label: Persons, Days & Awards
node.summary: Who's who in the news, important days and awards.

facts.text: **Kavli Prize** (astrophysics): Vasily Belokurov, Amina Helmi, Rodrigo Ibata, for discovering past mergers of the Milky Way.
facts.plain: Kavli Prize (astrophysics): Vasily Belokurov, Amina Helmi, Rodrigo Ibata, for discovering past mergers of the Milky Way.

facts.text: **National Unity Day** (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, since **2014**) is on **31 Oct**, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary. Statue of Unity: **182 m**, inaugurated 2018.
facts.plain: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, since 2014) is on 31 Oct, Sardar Patel's birth anniversary. Statue of Unity: 182 m, inaugurated 2018.

facts.text: World, in the news: Israel PM **Benjamin Netanyahu**; Iran FM **Abbas Araghchi**; UK Home Secretary **Shabana Mahmood**; Indonesia President **Prabowo Subianto**; Vietnam Defence Minister **Phan Van Giang**.

facts.text: Air Chief Marshal **Ashutosh Dixit** took over as the **29th Chief of the Air Staff** on 1 November 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, who retired after 43 years of service.
facts.plain: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit took over as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff on 1 November 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, who retired after 43 years of service.

facts.text: **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's** 151st birth anniversary fell on 31 October 2026 (National Unity Day/Rashtriya Ekta Diwas); retrospectives recalled his role integrating ~500 princely states and his post-Gandhi-assassination ban on the RSS, lifted after the RSS agreed to respect the tricolour.

facts.text: Painter **Jogen Chowdhury** (1939-2026), a **Padma Bhushan** awardee and **Rajya Sabha MP (2014-2020)**, died at 87.
